verdict.rationale: Codex Plugins is a plugin platform and ecosystem, not itself an agent, so shipping an official MCP server for outside agents is a fair question. The evidence only shows that plugins wrap MCP servers that ChatGPT and Codex consume as hosts (client-side), plus scaffolding for developers to wire up their own MCP servers. There is no first-party, official MCP server that an external agent can connect to; host consumption and developer building blocks earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
